other_conditions: The applicant must be the nominee or dependent of the deceased construction worker.
The deceased construction worker must have been a citizen of India.
The deceased must have been registered as a construction worker with the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
The deceased must have been at least 18 years old during their lifetime.
The deceased must not have turned 60 years old within the 12 months preceding the application.
The deceased must have contributed regularly to the welfare fund.
The deceased must not have defaulted on contributions for a continuous period of more than one year.
The application must be submitted within two months of the worker's death.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹70,000 is transferred directly to the nominee’s bank account within one month of application.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
